test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Flourish**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Flourish **means to grow or develop in a healthy or vigorous way. (स्वस्थ या सशक्त तरीके से बढ़ना या विकसित होना) • **Example**: *After implementing sustainable practices, the small business began to flourish.* • It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. • The sentence would mean that something is thriving or doing well. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Cherish **means to hold dear or treasure something. (किसी चीज़ को प्रिय या संजोकर रखना) • **Raise **means to lift or elevate something. (किसी चीज को ऊपर उठाना) • **Tend **means to take care of or look after something. (किसी चीज़ की देखभाल करना) 15d:T8e8, The correct answer is: **Derived**
